references.text: The same expression 'struck them with the edge of the sword' is used regarding Israel's conquest and destruction of enemy cities
Moses struck the inhabitants of Midian with the edge of the sword, the same war pattern that Joshua used at Ai
During the conquest of Jericho, Israel struck all the inhabitants with the edge of the sword, the same pattern as at Ai
Describes the same battle at Ai, where the enemies were surrounded and none escaped
Continuation of the account about Ai, where Joshua held his spear outstretched until everyone was killed
Joshua struck Makkedah with the edge of the sword and devoted all the inhabitants to destruction, the same pattern as at Ai
The conquest of Libnah follows the same pattern: all were struck with the edge of the sword
During the conquest of Hazor, Israel struck everyone with the edge of the sword and completely devoted them to destruction
